description.en: Unified controllable framework for English and Chinese speech and singing voice generation, voice conversion, and editing, with tokenizers that disentangle content, prosody, melody, style, and timbre.
description.zh: 面向中英文语音与歌声生成、音色转换与编辑的统一可控框架，其分词器可解耦内容、韵律、旋律、风格与音色。

route.en: Generation route; omitted selects the task default.
route.zh: 生成路线；省略选择任务默认值。

source_audio.en: Source audio file for conversion or editing.
source_audio.zh: 用于转换或编辑的源音频文件。

target_voice.en: Target voice audio file; overrides structured speaker audio.
target_voice.zh: 目标语音音频文件；覆盖结构化扬声器音频。

prosody_ref.en: Prosody or melody reference audio file.
prosody_ref.zh: 韵律或旋律参考音频文件。

target_text.en: Text or lyrics; overrides structured text input.
target_text.zh: 文字或歌词；覆盖结构化文本输入。

style_ref_text.en: Style-reference transcript; reference_text is also accepted.
style_ref_text.zh: 风格参考转录本； Reference_text 也被接受。

use_prosody_code.en: Use prosody codes; default depends on route and requires prosody audio when enabled.
use_prosody_code.zh: 使用韵律代码；默认值取决于路线，启用后需要韵律音频。

use_pitch_shift.en: Align reference pitch to the target voice; default depends on route.
use_pitch_shift.zh: 将参考音调与目标声音对齐；默认值取决于路由。

source_shift_steps.en: Manual source reference pitch shift in semitones.
source_shift_steps.zh: 手动源参考音调移动（以半音为单位）。

prosody_shift_steps.en: Manual prosody reference pitch shift in semitones.
prosody_shift_steps.zh: 手动韵律参考半音音高变化。

style_shift_steps.en: Manual style reference pitch shift in semitones.
style_shift_steps.zh: 以半音为单位的手动风格参考音高变换。

temperature.en: Positive AR sampling temperature; default comes from the checkpoint.
temperature.zh: 正AR采样温度；默认值来自检查点。

top_k.en: AR top-k sampling; default comes from the checkpoint.
top_k.zh: AR top-k采样；默认值来自检查点。

top_p.en: AR nucleus sampling; default comes from the checkpoint.
top_p.zh: AR细胞核取样；默认值来自检查点。

repetition_penalty.en: Positive AR repetition penalty; default comes from the checkpoint.
repetition_penalty.zh: 积极的 AR 重复惩罚；默认值来自检查点。

max_tokens.zh: 生成的 AR 代币的最大数量。

audio_chunk_duration_sec.en: Source-audio chunk duration for style_preserved_vc/svc; zero or omitted keeps one-shot processing.
audio_chunk_duration_sec.zh: style_preserved_vc/svc 的源音频块持续时间；零或省略保持一次性处理。

cross_fade_duration_sec.en: Source chunk overlap and output crossfade; must be smaller than chunk duration.
cross_fade_duration_sec.zh: 源块重叠和输出交叉淡入淡出；必须小于块持续时间。

duration_sec.en: Rescale prosody-code conditioning to this duration; not a general output-length limit. Legacy target_duration_seconds is accepted.
duration_sec.zh: 将韵律 code 条件缩放到该时长；不是通用输出长度限制。仍接受旧 target_duration_seconds。

reference_duration_sec.en: Trim target voice reference before conditioning. Legacy reference_duration_seconds is accepted.
reference_duration_sec.zh: 在条件化前裁剪目标音色参考。仍接受旧 reference_duration_seconds。

text_chunk_size.zh: 每个文本分块的字符预算。

audio_chunk_mode.en: Source-audio chunking for style_preserved_vc/svc requires audio_chunk_duration_sec. Auto uses fixed chunks; none disables chunking.
audio_chunk_mode.zh: style_preserved_vc/svc 的源音频分块需要 audio_chunk_duration_sec。auto 使用固定分块；none 关闭分块。
